subject: Small burst of tenant downtime — entitlement check and RCA request
messages:
From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@fastpay.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: support@fastpay.io
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Brief outage noticed on tenant 5421 (9/29 07:50-08:05)

Hi Karthik,

We observed a short window of errors affecting a subset of our checkout traffic this morning in us-west-2. Between ~07:50 and 08:05 PDT we saw elevated 503s and a spike in client-side retries; our telemetry shows roughly 2.3% of requests for tenant 5421 failed during that window which had business impact.

Could you confirm whether this meets Redwood's SLA downtime definition and whether FastPay is eligible for a proportional credit? If helpful, I've attached a small log bundle from our side and a short timeline.

Attachments: fastpay_frontend_logs_20260929.txt (text), customer-timeline.csv (csv)

Thanks — we need to include this in today's incident log for finance and our pager.

—Sam
Sam Patel
Head of Platform
FastPay
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@fastpay.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Brief outage noticed on tenant 5421 (9/29 07:50-08:05)

Sam — thanks for the heads up and for the attached timeline. Sorry for the impact this morning.

Short answers up front:
- We'll validate the exact availability window on our side and confirm whether it qualifies as an SLA "unavailable" period under the contract for tenant 5421.
- If eligible, we'll calculate a proportional credit and share the arithmetic.
- We'll also propose a post-incident review and include traces/kv-cache dumps.

Laura / Aditya — can you pull the tracing and proxy error counts for tenant 5421 in us-west-2 from 07:40–08:15 PDT and confirm whether this aligns with FastPay's observed 503 spike? Please include any observed routing fallback events or autoscaler churn. Also include the raw serving node list and any preemptions.

Sam — I attached our evidence-request template to make it easier to line up telemetry. If you can share any additional client traces (with request ids) that will speed verification. We'll aim to confirm eligibility and a proposed credit by EOD today.

Best,
Karthik
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
Attachments: request_evidence_template.csv (csv)
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Brief outage noticed on tenant 5421 (9/29 07:50-08:05)

Adding what I pulled from the control plane:

- Proxy error rate: confirmed elevated 5xx for tenant 5421 between 07:49:58–08:04:47 PDT. Peak 5xx rate ~9.1% on one host, tailing off after a routing retry window.
- Observed autoscaler spin / pod churn event at 07:51:04 PDT in the pool serving that tenant — logs show a transient preemption on a GPU instance, followed by a short period of degraded capacity while new pods came up.
- KV cache eviction spikes coincident with the preemption, causing increased cold starts and extra tokenization CPU on some workers.
- No global control-plane outage; impact appears isolated to the tenant shard in us-west-2.

I'm packaging a raw trace bundle and selected SRE logs into support_log_snapshot_20260929.zip (see attached). Laura, can you validate whether the above time window meets our contractual "unavailable" thresholds (per SLA: continuous unavailability > 1 minute where successful responses drop below 99.5%)? Also compute a proportional credit if eligible.

Aditya
SRE (Serving Runtime) — Redwood Inference
Attachments: support_log_snapshot_20260929.zip (log bundle)

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@fastpay.io>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Final: entitlement determination and postmortem invite — tenant 5421 (9/29)

Sam / FastPay team — thanks for your patience. Summary and next steps below.

Summary of findings (short):
- Scope: impact isolated to tenant shard 5421 in us-west-2.
- Window: 2026-09-29T07:49:58-07:08:04 PDT (16m50s) where successful responses for that tenant fell under the contractual threshold.
- Root cause: a preemption of a hot serving instance in the dedicated pool led to temporary capacity loss and a KV cache eviction storm that amplified tail-latency. Autoscaler recovered but there was sustained error amplification during ramp.
- Eligibility: under Section 3.2 of the Master Services Agreement, this window qualifies as an SLA unavailability event; FastPay is eligible for a proportional credit.

Credit calculation:
- Monthly committed spend: $72,000 (from contract)
- Credit basis: prorated on affected minutes relative to monthly minutes. Provisional credit: $43.20 (calculation attached). We'll finalize after finance signoff but wanted to provide the number transparently.

Next steps / postmortem:
- We're scheduling a technical postmortem with SRE, Product, and FastPay (30–45 minutes). Proposed slot: Thu 09/30 14:00 PDT. Please confirm availability; we'll share a readout and action items.
- Immediate mitigations: increase preemption buffer on the affected pool, add guardrails to KV eviction logic, and add a short-term routing fallback threshold to reduce error amplification.

Attachments: calculation_workbook.xlsx (calc), postmortem-invite.ics (calendar)

Sam — if you're comfortable with the credit and the proposed remediation timeline, I can open the formal finance ticket and we will process the credit within the next billing cycle.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
